implied_dimensions_mm.note: The same mm/CSS value is applied to the unmeasured axis; that is an assumption, not a second measurement.

decision.message: The ruler implies 153.60 mm for the x dimension; the supplied dimension is 150.00 mm. Both are shown. Choose which value to keep or re-measure; nothing has been changed.

choices.label: Keep the supplied dimension
choices.consequence: Keep 150.00 mm for the x dimension. The ruler scale is not saved, so the existing mapping remains unchanged.

choices.label: Save the ruler scale
choices.consequence: Save a new calibration revision with 0.2 mm/CSS and an implied 153.60 mm x extent. Existing revisions and layouts that pin them stay unchanged.

choices.label: Measure again
choices.consequence: Repeat the measurement with a longer span to reduce extrapolation, then compare both values again.

actionable_warning.message: The ruler implies 153.60 mm for the x dimension; the supplied dimension is 150.00 mm. Both are shown. Choose which value to keep or re-measure; nothing has been changed.
actionable_warning.action: Choose keep_supplied, use_ruler, or remeasure; this helper never changes the supplied value.

assumptions: The ruler span and error are explicit inputs; no model substitution occurred.
Implied dimensions use the supplied usable viewport CSS size.
The unmeasured axis uses the same scale as an explicit assumption.
This arithmetic does not establish a 2 mm accuracy target.
note: Prospective calculation only. No profile, calibration revision, saved layout, or live mapping was written.
